an7.24:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] satta vo bhikkhave, aparihānīye dhamme desissāmi.
an7.24:1.3: katame ca bhikkhave, satta aparihānīyā dhammā:
an7.24:2.1: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū na kammārāmā bhavissanti, na kammārāmataṃ anuyuttā, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
an7.24:3.1: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, bhikkhū na bhassārāmā bhavissanti …pe…
an7.24:3.4: na pāpicchā bhavissanti na pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā …pe…
an7.24:3.5: na pāpamittā bhavissanti na pāpasahāyā na pāpasampavaṅkā …pe…
an7.24:3.6: na oramattakena visesādhigamena antarāvosānaṃ āpajjissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
an7.24:4.1: yāvakīvañca bhikkhave, ime satta aparihānīyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihānīyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandissanti, vuddhiyeva bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihānīti.
